approved_claim_dependencies.claim: The Entity Document block supports per-document security when that feature is enabled in the block settings, while deleting a listed document is irreversible.
Users can manage merge templates intended for their own use from My Settings, and the page can also expose global templates when its block settings are configured accordingly.
Cloudflare Scrape Shield must be disabled for HTML merge documents that need to display email addresses because the feature blocks those addresses in the generated document.
Rock merge documents support Word and HTML formats, with Lava used to supply templated content in either format.

A workflow Electronic Signature action can use a fixed document template or resolve a template ID or GUID from a workflow attribute; the fixed template setting takes precedence when both are supplied.

source_refs.title: Use Electronic Signatures in a Workflow

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: In Rock 19.0, administrators can manage documents for a signature template from Admin Tools > Settings > Signature Documents, where a document record can be opened to inspect its details, view the signed file, or resend the completion email.

The Entity Document Add workflow action fails when the workflow entity type does not match the entity type configured for the selected document type; the uploaded file must also satisfy any required preferred-file settings of that document type's associated file type.

For an event registration signature document, Applies To is each registrant; Assigned To is the registrant when the registrant is an adult, but the person completing the registration when the registrant is a child.

source_refs.title: Use Electronic Signatures in Event Registrations

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: To manage documents for an entity type other than Person, add a Documents block to a page that has that entity in context and configure the block's Entity Type to match; otherwise, the block warns that it lacks a valid context entity.
In Rock electronic signatures, Applies To identifies the subject of the document, Assigned To identifies the expected signer, and Signed By records the person who completed the signature.
In Rock 19.0 event registration, electronic signatures require the Obsidian Registration Entry block; using that block with a legacy signature document can break the registration flow.

source_refs.title: Use Electronic Signatures in Event Registrations

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: When preparing grid data for a merge document, Rock can preview the first 15 source records and display the available merge fields before the merge is run.
Uploading a document for a person requires Edit permission for both the applicable Person document type and its associated Person Document file type.
An entity document type binds stored documents to both a Rock entity type and a file type, and optional qualifier column and value settings can restrict it to a subset such as one Group Type.
The Entity Document block can manage documents for any Rock entity; the document types available for adding are determined by entity document type configuration and the block's settings.
A Documents block can be limited to selected document types, and enabling its security button allows access security to be managed separately for each document.
Entity Documents can associate multiple documents of the same document type with a single Rock entity, including a person or group.

Word merge templates support Lava variables, filters, and most tags, but not the if, raw, or lava tags, Lava commands, or Lava shortcodes; using a Next tag creates multi-record layouts such as mailing labels, while templates without it repeat the whole document for each record.
Rock recommends typed signatures because a drawn signature is personally identifiable information that can create additional legal obligations when stored in Rock.

When a merge document receives GroupMember rows, Rock exposes each row as a person and makes the original membership data available through the person's GroupMember property, including group member attributes.
Lava expressions in merge templates should use straight quotation marks because curved or stylized quotation marks can cause parsing errors.
After an electronic signature is completed, Rock normally generates a PDF containing the document content and signature so a copy can be sent to the signer.

source_refs.title: Generate PDFs for Electronic Signature Documents

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Global merge templates are available database-wide, but administrators can restrict individual templates on the Merge Template Detail block; Rock enforces those security settings whenever a merge document is created.

Organizations should configure a third-party PDF service through the PDF External Render Endpoint system setting when local PDF rendering would create excessive server load; an external service is required when the Rock environment cannot run Puppeteer or Chrome, including applicable Azure Web Services deployments.

source_refs.title: Generate PDFs for Electronic Signature Documents

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: In Rock 19.0, access to view a completed electronic signature document is controlled by the security permissions of its associated binary file type, rather than by the document template's security settings.
The merge document option to combine family members produces one row per family instead of one row per person and combines member values such as nicknames within that row.
